about_the_game:
Story

Return to Atria, where the Great City of Pando has been thrust into chaos. Religious ideology runs rampant, fueled by the terrifying prophecy of The Ember Oracle, a Vita believed to herald Pando's very destruction.

Join Sin-Nul, a Vita caught between fate and the radical ideas spread by the Ever Flame of Pando. His journey through the city's sprawling, chaotic districts will plunge him into a desperate struggle for truth and survival.

In a Story of Profound Discovery. The Ember Oracle delivers a rich narrative steeped in themes of self-discovery and the abuse of people's beliefs for control. Unravel a tale that challenges perceptions and reveals the true cost of power.

Ignite your inner flame in Vita: The Ember Oracle. The third story of the epic the Vita saga.

Features

Explore a World Reborn:

  • Experience an update Duel-Resource Turn-Based battle system (DRTBS).

  • Earth skill points in battle to learn new abilities to dominate your enemies.

  • Craft the perfect synergy with character load outs

  • Dynamic Party Switching allows you to switch party members mid combat to gain the upper hand

  • Traverse four unique regions within the city of Pando, each inspired by distinct Late Middle Age European cultures.

  • Updated Visuals: Experience the world of Atria like never before, with updated graphics that breathe new life into every environment.

  • Realized Character Portraits: Connect deeply with your cast through beautifully rendered character portraits.

Why Play Vita: The Ember Oracle?

An RPG with a Soul: We don’t just build games; we build worlds. Vita: The Ember Oracle is a labor of love, crafted by hand to bring back the feeling of the classic adventures we grew up with. Where the story matters as the mirror is turned on human history and cultures

  • A belief that spread like wildfire: The city of Pando isn't just a fantasy city. But a city inspired by European cities and culture

  • A Fighter's Heart: Combat isn't just about mashing buttons. It’s about mastering the elements and finding the perfect synergy, managing resources and party management.

  • Your Time Matters: The Vita series is designed to be short form RPGs. We don't always have 6 or 7 hours to sit and play a game in today's world. The Vita stories get to the point, So you can enjoy a great story, and then go about your life. 

  • A work of Passion: The Vita series is created by a Solo Developer. This series was never about creating a one off game, but building an entire world, with culture, personality and crafted with love for the art of video games.

content_descriptors.notes: This game explores themes of religion and faith. Its story is crafted not to promote or discredit any particular belief, but to foster understanding and empathy between different perspectives.

name: Vita: The Ember Oracle

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4340 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Compatible OpenGL/CRAM 1gb or better
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1280x720 display or better
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5600 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon 580 or Better
  • Storage: 7 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1280x720 display or better

short_description: The flames of faith ignite Pando. Follow Sin-Nul on his path of self-discovery as he becomes entangled in a zealous prophecy. Will you be the flame that destroys the city, or the Ember that sets it ablaze?
